product_metadata.title: Classic Turkish Towels - Extra Large Premium Cotton Bath Sheet Set - Thick and Absorbent, Ribbed 2-Piece Luxury Bathroom Towels, 40x65 inches, 100% Turkish Cotton (Mauve)
features: Luxurious Bath Towels - Enjoy the quality of hotel and spa towels in the comfort of your home with these ribbed bath sheets made of 100% Turkish cotton.
Super Absorbent - The high-quality cotton material allows for maximum absorbency. These towels dry quickly between uses and are perfect for drying your body, face, and hair.
Longevity & Comfort - Our 620 GSM bathroom towels feel ultra-soft and plush against your skin while remaining thick and durable for long-term use.
High-Quality Set - Includes 2 extra-large 40-by-65-inch towels, woven in a jacquard style with a double-stitched hem. They’re OEKO-TEX certified and chemical free.
Care Tips - To extend the longevity of your luxury bath towels, machine-wash in warm or cold water. Always wash before first use to improve absorbency and softness. Avoid bleach and fabric softener.
description: The Brampton Collection features luxurious hotel and spa-quality bath towels, bath sheets, hand towels, washcloths, and bath mats for your home. This set of two Turkish cotton bath sheets will bring elegance and comfort to any bathroom. These 40 by 65-inch towels are made with a stunning ribbed Jacquard design that beautifully accents the style of any home. Feel the lush softness when you dry your body, face, and hair with these extra-large towels. The high-quality cotton fibers allow for maximum absorbency, ensuring these towels dry quickly between uses. All our towels are easy to clean and care for. To extend the longevity of your towels, simply machine-wash in warm or cold water. Avoid bleach and fabric softener. All our bath products are manufactured and imported directly from Turkey, using only premium 100% Turkish cotton that is plush, durable, and soft. Turkish cotton is prized for its long-lasting soft texture which naturally grows in longer, more narrow fibers. This results in more threads per square inch and a naturally softer texture. Complete your bathroom look with the entire Brampton Collection towel set.
